name: forge3d
description: Prompt-first local workflows for creating game-ready 3D assets with Blender and Godot.

interface.longDescription: Turns natural-language requests into editable Blender masters and validated Godot assets using local models, deterministic Blender tasks, and direct Blender and Godot MCP review.
defaultPrompt: Create a game-ready prop and validate it in Blender and Godot.
Rig this character and test its deformation.
Retarget these animations to my new rig.
